description: Defines the interface for the ReportingService class in the net reporting system, including methods for queuing reports, processing headers, setting endpoints, and managing reporting data.

classes.name: ReportingService
classes.description: An abstract class providing the interface for reporting functionalities such as queuing reports, processing headers, setting endpoints, and managing reporting data.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a ReportingService instance with specified policy, request context, and optional persistent store.

methods.name: CreateForTesting
methods.description: Creates a ReportingService instance for testing with a pre-constructed ReportingContext.

methods.name: QueueReport
methods.description: Queues a report for delivery with specified parameters.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeader
methods.description: Processes a Report-To header from a given origin.

methods.name: SetDocumentReportingEndpoints
methods.description: Configures reporting endpoints for a specific reporting source.

methods.name: SendReportsAndRemoveSource
methods.description: Sends queued reports and removes the reporting source.

methods.name: RemoveBrowsingData
methods.description: Removes browsing data with a filter.

methods.name: RemoveAllBrowsingData
methods.description: Removes all browsing data without filter.

methods.name: StatusAsValue
methods.description: Returns the status of the reporting service as a value.

methods.name: GetV1ReportingEndpointsByOrigin
methods.description: Gets reporting endpoints grouped by origin.

methods.name: AddReportingCacheObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for reporting cache changes.

methods.name: RemoveReportingCacheObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for reporting cache changes.

methods.name: GetContextForTesting
methods.description: Returns the reporting context for testing purposes.
